Subject: Evidence & DPIA support requested for Finvera onboarding

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we progress toward procurement approval, Legal and Security at Finvera have a few concrete evidence requests to complete our onboarding packet. Please see the list below — KPMG (copied) will use these to validate our audit scope.

High-level asks:
- Confirmation of audit rights (can KPMG perform an on-site/remote review under Art.28 obligations and how is scope constrained?)
- DPA with subprocessors exhibit (current inventory + notification cadence)
- Excerpt of our processing records (Art.30 register) for the services Finvera will use (tokenization, embeddings, session logs)
- Sample KMS wrap/unwrap logs or attestation showing key management used for customer data
- DPIA support checklist + any DPIs Redwood has completed for similar banking workloads
- Clarify cross-border transfer protections: SCCs or UK Addendum + any supplementary safeguards used in your dedicated/private offerings

Could you confirm what you can deliver this week and whether we need a short call to discuss scoping? KPMG would ideally receive a packaged zip with documentation and a single point of contact.

Appreciate a clear timeline — procurement is targeting a final review by Apr 6.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager — Finvera
procurement@finvera.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Evidence & DPIA support requested for Finvera onboarding

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the bulk of this material and coordinate a short walkthrough with KPMG. Quick responses to your bullets: 

- Audit rights: Redwood supports remote evidence reviews and controlled on-site reviews for enterprise customers under our DPA audit clause. We typically provide scoped artifacts and a live walkthrough; on-site visits require 30 days' notice and an agreed scope.
- DPA & subprocessors: we will attach the current subprocessor exhibit (exportable PDF) and a change-notification policy doc. We push subprocessor updates to customers 30 days before changes.
- Art.30 excerpt: we'll generate a CSV extract limited to Finvera-relevant processing categories and dates.
- KMS logs: we cannot share raw HSM keys; we can provide wrap/unwrap event logs (redacted) and an attestation of key custody practices.
- DPIA support: we'll include a DPIA support matrix and offer a 60-minute technical session with our privacy engineering lead to review residual risk items.
- Transfers: SCCs are available for EU customers; for the UK we have a UK Addendum. For Dedicated/Private we can outline mitigation (data residency + on-prem options).

I'll coordinate attachments and propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to run through any scope clarifications. Kimberly — can you confirm legal's suggested artifact package and whether we need any further approvals before sending artifacts to KPMG?

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
415-555-0192

Ben / team — I reviewed Finvera's list. We can provide the following packaged artifacts (attached):

1) redwood_dpa_subprocessor_exhibit.pdf — current list of subprocessors with service categories and locations
2) processing-register-art30-excerpt.csv — Art.30-style processing record excerpt scoped to Finvera services
3) kms-wrap-log-sample-2027.log — redacted KMS wrap/unwrap event log sample (no key material)
4) dpia-support-matrix.xlsx — mapping of typical banking processing to controls and recommended compensating measures
5) DPA standard + UK Addendum (we will include links and the latest signed template)

Legal notes / constraints:
- KPMG may receive the above artifacts for their review; if they request any system-level logs beyond the redacted KMS sample, we will need a formal data-access agreement and a defined retention window.
- For on-site reviews, security must set the scope; we typically limit access to non-production environments unless otherwise agreed.
- Subprocessor updates are sent 30 days in advance; if Finvera requires a contractual right to audit subprocessors directly, that will need an addendum to the DPA.

Ben — please send the package to Finvera and KPMG. Offer the 60-minute technical session with Marissa leading the DPIA walkthrough; propose times.

Kimberly Park
